summary: CICS online Account View screen. A pseudo-conversational transaction: the user enters an account number, the program validates it, then reads the card cross-reference, account and customer records to display the full account detail. Read-only inquiry (no updates). Handles PF-key navigation (Enter to inquire, PF3 to return to the menu) via a 2000-byte COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. If this is the first entry (no COMMAREA), initialize and send the account-view screen. On re-entry, evaluate the pressed key: PF3 returns to the calling menu; Enter processes the input (receive + validate the account, then read and display the account); other keys re-display with an error. Finish by returning to CICS with the transaction id and COMMAREA.

annotations.note: Pseudo-conversational CICS pattern: state is carried in the COMMAREA between screen interactions.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save this program's state into the COMMAREA and issue CICS RETURN with the transaction id so the next key-press re-enters this program.

paragraphs.name: 1000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the account-view map by initializing the screen, setting up its variables and attributes, then transmitting it.

paragraphs.name: 1100-SCREEN-INIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize the map area and load title/date/time header fields.

paragraphs.name: 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Move the account and customer data fields into the map's display fields.

paragraphs.name: 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set field attributes/colors (e.g. highlight fields in error, position the cursor).
branches: IF field in error -> set attribute

paragraphs.name: 1400-SEND-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Transmit the map to the terminal (CICS SEND MAP).

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the screen, then edit/validate the entered inputs.

paragraphs.name: 2100-RECEIVE-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map from the terminal (CICS RECEIVE MAP) into the input fields.

paragraphs.name: 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the entered inputs by editing the account number.

paragraphs.name: 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the account number: it must be supplied, numeric, and a valid 11-digit account id (non-zero). If invalid, set an error message and mark the field in error.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: the account number must be present, numeric and a valid 11-digit account id before the account can be read.

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-ACCT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account detail chain: get the card cross-reference by account, then the account master data, then the customer data.

paragraphs.name: 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card cross-reference by account id (CICS READ) to obtain the customer id; on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account master by account id (CICS READ); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the customer master by customer id (CICS READ); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: SEND-PLAIN-TEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Send a short plain-text message to the terminal (e.g. for errors before the map exists).

paragraphs.name: SEND-LONG-TEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Send a longer plain-text message to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: ABEND-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: On an unrecoverable error, display an abend message and terminate the transaction (CICS ABEND).
